parties: Olin Mendis v. W. Sillinona and Others Olin Mendis v. W. Sillinona and Others View More
keywords: The Petitioner sought leave to appeal against an order confirming a commissioner\'s scheme of partition, contending that the allotment unfairly affected access to a house on an adjoining lot. Held - a commissioner\'s scheme should not be disturbed unless compelling grounds are established; Finding that the commissioner had made an equitable division of the land, including allocating coastal frontage fairly, Application refused without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
